unit.title: Weather, Travel and the World Around Us

theory.title: Talking about holiday activities and places to visit
theory.explanation: Use the past simple to describe completed holiday activities: We visited the castle. Regular verbs usually add -ed; some common verbs are irregular, such as go–went, see–saw and buy–bought. Use did/didn't + base verb for questions and negatives. Use was/were to describe places and experiences. Use could to ask politely about tours and tickets.
theory.tip: Say visit a museum, go on a walking tour and take photos. Remember: Did you visit...? but You visited...; after did, use the base verb.

patterns.label: Block 1 · Past simple regular
examples: They walked around the old town.

patterns.label: Block 2 · Past simple irregular
examples: We went on a boat trip.

patterns.label: Block 7 · Polite information questions
examples: Could you tell me the opening time?
Could I have two tickets, please?

patterns.label: Block 8 · Asking about tours
examples: Is there a guided tour today?
How long does the tour last?

patterns.label: Block 10 · Giving an opinion
examples: The boat trip was really interesting.
I enjoyed the walking tour because it was fun.

content.passage: Last Saturday, Mia and her brother went to York for the day. First, they visited the old castle. The guided tour started at eleven, and the guide told them stories about the town. Mia thought the castle was fascinating. After that, they walked through the old town and saw a beautiful cathedral. They had lunch in the main square, next to a fountain. In the afternoon, they went to an art gallery. Mia liked the paintings, but her brother preferred the modern exhibition. They didn't buy souvenirs because the shops were expensive. Before they went home, they took lots of photos near the river. They both said it was a wonderful day.

content.audioTranscript: Hello, Sam. How was your day in Bath? It was great. In the morning, we visited the Roman baths and saw an interesting exhibition. Then we walked to the cathedral. Did you go inside? Yes, we did. The building was beautiful. After lunch, we went on a boat trip along the river. How much was the ticket? It was twelve pounds. We wanted to visit the art gallery too, but it was closed. So we bought postcards and took some photos in the old town. That sounds like a lovely day.
